newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair to pick new plane by summer hols.
newsitem.headline: Finnair to pick new plane by summer hols.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy will decide before the summer holidays which plane type it will buy for the renewal of its fleet of medium-range aircraft for European routes, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"The intention is to make the decision before the summer holidays," she said by telephone.

Finnair said on March 21 it had invited offers from European Airbus Industries and U.S. Boeing Co for 12 aircraft for delivery in 1999-2001 to replace its ageing fleet of DC9s. This acquisition would cost around two billion markka.
The contract would include options for additional aircraft.
Finnair said in March that no deadline had been set for the decision to order.
On Tuesday, the spokeswoman said it was possible, but not certain, that the decision on the new plane type would be announced on June 13 with Finnair's results for the financial year to end-March.
The Finnish summer holiday season usually starts around the midsummer weekend, which this year begins on Friday June 20.
